title: AIxDaily
overview_zh: 今日精选：AI × Chem 10 项，AI × Bio 14 项，AI × Math 6 项，AI Voices 9 项，Engineering 10 项。今日五个频道共同聚焦科研智能体与可验证方法。AI×Chem、AI×Bio、AI×Math 的前三项均为预印本，报告了模型、基准或实验数据，但尚待同行评议；AI Voices 收录公开帖文与机构观点，相关性能主张仍需独立核验；Engineering 展示 GitHub Trending 项目。本次所阅前三项中未见同行评议论文或正式软件发布。

channel_highlights.aixchem: 三篇 bioRxiv 预印本聚焦细胞表型与虚拟筛选、逆合成感知的 SMILES 表示及抗菌肽多标签预测，实验和基准结果仍需后续验证。
channel_highlights.aixbio: 三项预印本分别探索医学影像推理与分割、蛋白质组基础模型和长读长辐射转录组；临床价值及跨队列泛化尚待更大规模研究。
channel_highlights.aixmath: 三篇 arXiv 预印本关注科研代理实验一致性、语言变化下的图推理和符号逻辑求解，所报性能仅适用于各自的评测任务与设置。
channel_highlights.aivoices: 公开帖文介绍语音智能体模型、递归自我改进基准及自动化对齐研究；其中性能与安全结论主要来自发布方或官方材料，应审慎解读。
channel_highlights.engineering: 前三项为 GitHub Trending 项目，涉及多智能体课堂、科研技能库与架构图生成，反映开发者关注度，尚不能等同于成熟软件发布。

breaking_news.headline_zh: 实时神经外科视觉分割公布首次人体早期评估
breaking_news.summary_zh: 一项 medRxiv 预印本公布内窥镜垂体手术实时像素级解剖分割的首次人体早期评估：8名患者中6例成功部署，采用前瞻性观察与盲法回顾，未报告与 AI 有关的并发症。结果仅支持小样本可行性。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 从离线影像算法走向术中实时视觉导航，是医疗 AI 临床转化的重要进展；首次人体证据虽有限，仍直接关联手术工作流与患者安全。

breaking_news.headline_zh: Pipecat 团队公布开放语音智能体模型 PhoneLLM
breaking_news.summary_zh: Pipecat 团队成员通过公开帖文推出开放权重的 PhoneLLM Alpha 1，并发布权重、PhoneBench 和部署材料。发布方称，该模型在典型语音智能体任务上可达到 GPT 5.6 Terra 性能，同时延迟约为三分之一、成本约为十八分之一。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 语音智能体长期受制于时延、费用和可控部署；若这些基准经复核，开放模型可明显改变客服与电话自动化等应用的技术选型。

items.title: A pretrained unified model enables cellular functional profile prediction and multi-objective virtual drug screening
items.abstract_or_text: Cells are characterized by molecular states, coordinated molecular interactions, regulatory programs, and responses to perturbations. Systematic mapping of these cellular functional profiles across biological contexts remains experimentally costly and fragmented. Here we present InsilicoCell, a pretrained multi-modal, multi-task model that unifies prediction of cellular functional profiles spanning molecular states, molecular interactions, and perturbation-induced responses. Built on a supervised transformer architecture and pretrained on more than 88 million measurements across seven tasks, including drug sensitivity, drug-induced gene expression, and drug-protein binding, InsilicoCell learns a shared representation that links molecular profiles to cellular phenotypes, improves performance over task-specific models, and generalizes to unseen entities, contexts, and conditions. InsilicoCell extends beyond cell line systems to patient, spatial and single-cell settings, and enables multi-objective virtual drug screening. It identifies novel candidate compounds with experimental validation, including c-Myc activity inhibitors, antifibrotic agents and stemness-inducing compounds. Together, InsilicoCell provides a scalable framework for predictive cellular biology and therapeutic discovery.
items.summary_zh: InsilicoCell 以监督式 Transformer 预训练整合七类细胞功能任务、逾 8,800 万条测量，并用于多目标虚拟筛选；摘要报告了 c-Myc 活性抑制剂、抗纤维化剂和促干性化合物的实验验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将药敏、药物诱导基因表达和药物—蛋白结合纳入同一表示，有望连接细胞表型预测与先导发现。需留意其跨实体与临床场景的泛化程度，以及候选化合物的验证规模尚未由摘要充分说明。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞具有分子状态、协调的分子相互作用、调控程序和对扰动的响应。在不同生物学情境中系统绘制这些细胞功能图谱，实验成本仍然高昂且数据彼此割裂。我们提出 InsilicoCell，这是一种预训练的多模态、多任务模型，统一预测涵盖分子状态、分子相互作用和扰动诱导响应的细胞功能图谱。InsilicoCell 建立在监督式 Transformer 架构之上，在包括药物敏感性、药物诱导基因表达和药物—蛋白结合在内的七项任务、超过 8,800 万条测量上预训练，学习将分子图谱与细胞表型相连的共享表示；其性能优于任务专用模型，并可泛化至未见实体、情境和条件。InsilicoCell 的适用范围超出细胞系系统，延伸至患者、空间和单细胞场景，并支持多目标虚拟药物筛选。它鉴定出经实验验证的新候选化合物，包括 c-Myc 活性抑制剂、抗纤维化剂和促干性化合物。总体而言，InsilicoCell 为预测性细胞生物学和治疗发现提供了可扩展的框架。

items.title: Can SMILES be fragmented into a concatenable ordered sequence of retrosynthetically interesting string block ?
items.abstract_or_text: Molecules generated by deep learning models are often difficult to synthesize. Their synthetic accessibility can be improved with automated retrosynthetic analysis, which allows for identifying synthons. However, synthons in a SMILES can be scattered throughout the string depending on the path taken through the molecular graph used to generate the SMILES. We tested whether the ensemble of possible SMILES for a molecule can be used to generate a concatenable ordered sequence of string fragments (blocks) from SMILES that match potential synthons obtained through automated retrosynthetic analysis. We found that exhaustively sampling the SMILES space of a molecule improves the coverage of retrosynthetic breaks. We achieved full coverage of retrosynthetic bonds in string form for 85\% of the 1.9 million molecules in the MOSES dataset. Doing so allowed us to test our block SMILES in an unconditional de novo drug design test case with MolGPT and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). We found that using blocks as an LLM's token did degrade MolGPT performance due to the curse of dimensionality. However, using the SMILES selected by our blocking algorithm with the default SMILES tokenizer improved the reproduction of physico-chemical properties of samples and also improved uniqueness, novelty, and validity. The MCTS outperforms our MolGPT models in terms of validity and novelty. However, samples generated by the MCTS had physico-chemical properties that were further away from the MOSES baseline than the samples produced by molGPT, with an improved distribution of quantitative estimation of drug-likeness (QED).
items.summary_zh: 研究通过穷举 SMILES 表示来构造与逆合成断键对应的可拼接字符串块，在 MOSES 的 190 万个分子中为 85%实现全部逆合成键的字符串覆盖，并测试其对 MolGPT 与 MCTS 从头设计的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作试图把可合成性信息更早地嵌入生成表示，可为生成分子的可制备性改善提供新思路。结果也显示将块直接作为 LLM token 会损害 MolGPT 表现，且 MCTS 样本的理化性质偏离 MOSES 基线，实际效用仍须在更接近药物化学的任务中检验。
items.abstract_zh: 深度学习模型生成的分子往往难以合成。自动化逆合成分析可识别合成子，从而改善其合成可及性。然而，取决于生成 SMILES 所采用的分子图路径，SMILES 中的合成子可能分散在字符串各处。我们测试了能否利用一个分子的全部可能 SMILES，从与自动化逆合成分析获得的潜在合成子相匹配的 SMILES 中生成可拼接的有序字符串片段序列（块）。我们发现，对分子的 SMILES 空间进行穷举采样可提高逆合成断键的覆盖率。在 MOSES 数据集的 190 万个分子中，我们为 85%的分子实现了逆合成键在字符串形式中的完整覆盖。这使我们能够在一个无条件从头药物设计案例中，用 MolGPT 和 Monte Carlo Tree Search（MCTS）测试块 SMILES。我们发现，由于维度灾难，将这些块作为 LLM 的 token 会降低 MolGPT 性能。然而，使用由我们的分块算法选出的 SMILES 并保留默认 SMILES tokenizer，可改善样本理化性质的再现，并提高唯一性、新颖性和有效性。MCTS 在有效性和新颖性方面优于我们的 MolGPT 模型。然而，与 molGPT 生成的样本相比，MCTS 生成样本的理化性质离 MOSES 基线更远，但其定量药物相似性估计（QED）分布有所改善。
items.author_line: Reboul, E., Prabakaran, H., Waldispuhl, J., Taly, A.

items.title: Coarse composition suffices: tabular in-context learning for multi-activity antimicrobial peptide profiling
items.abstract_or_text: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) often act against multiple pathogen classes, making multi-label activity prediction a more realistic screening target than binary antimicrobial classification. The ESCAPE benchmark formalizes this setting, but leading approaches typically rely on multimodal, structure-conditioned deep models that are costly to train and tune. We show that a simple, sequence-only pipeline can match and surpass these methods by combining 330 interpretable sequence descriptors with TabPFN, a tabular foundation model that performs in-context prediction in a single forward pass without gradient-based training or hyperparameter search. On ESCAPE (82,359 peptides; five labels), a label-powerset TabPFN model achieves mAP-5=77.8%, improving on the previously best reported 72.1%. A probabilistic classifier chain is the first method to match or exceed the best published average precision on each of the five labels simultaneously. The gains persist under the prior state-of-the-art single-fold training protocol, indicating they are not a training-set-size artefact, and are largest for remote homologues (+11.2 points below 30% sequence identity). Ablations further show that predicted structure is unnecessary at inference and that performance is not driven by any single descriptor family: ten global physicochemical scalars recover 91% of full-feature performance. Finally, explicitly modelling label dependence yields targeted benefits for scarce activities and supports ranking which activity to assay next from partial positive evidence.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以 330 个可解释序列描述符结合表格基础模型 TabPFN，在 ESCAPE 的 82,359 条抗菌肽、五标签任务上完成免训练的多活性预测，并报告 mAP-5 达 77.8%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果表明简单、可解释的序列特征与表格基础模型可在多标签抗菌肽筛选中达到强基准表现，尤其改善远缘同源序列预测。证据仍主要来自单一公开基准，模型对真实实验筛选命中率和新病原体谱系的迁移能力有待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 抗菌肽（AMPs）常对多种病原体类别起作用，因此多标签活性预测比二元抗菌分类更贴近实际筛选目标。ESCAPE 基准将这一情境形式化，但领先方法通常依赖多模态、结构条件化的深度模型，训练和调参成本较高。我们表明，一个简单的仅序列流程可与这些方法匹敌并超越它们：该流程将 330 个可解释序列描述符与 TabPFN 相结合；TabPFN 是一种表格基础模型，能在单次前向传播中进行上下文预测，无需基于梯度的训练或超参数搜索。在 ESCAPE（82,359 条肽；五个标签）上，标签幂集 TabPFN 模型达到 mAP-5=77.8%，超过此前报道的最佳值 72.1%。概率分类器链是首个能同时达到或超过五个标签各自已发表最佳平均精确率的方法。在此前最先进的单折训练方案下，这些增益仍然存在，表明其并非训练集规模造成的假象；对远缘同源序列的增益最大（序列同一性低于 30%时提高 11.2 个点）。消融实验还表明，推理时不需要预测结构，且性能并非由任何单一描述符家族驱动：十个全局理化标量即可恢复完整特征性能的 91%。最后，显式建模标签依赖性可为稀缺活性带来有针对性的收益，并可根据部分阳性证据支持对下一项待测活性进行排序。
items.author_line: Kumar, R., Pal, A., Solanki, D., Pareek, P., Singh, J., Singla, J.

items.title: RPDynaFlow: Generating RNA-Protein Conformational Ensembles by Atomic Conditional Flow Matching
items.abstract_or_text: Conformation ensembles of biomolecules provide the basis for understanding structural transformations and drug design. Deep-learning generative models have advanced protein and small molecule ensemble generation, while RNA-Protein complexes remain unaddressed due to the chemical heterogeneity, limited dataset size and the different flexibility scales of RNA and protein components. We present RPDynaFlow, a flow-matching model to generate conformation ensembles of RNA-protein complexes, trained on 600 ns trajectories of molecular dynamics(MD) simulation. The results show our model extends the sampling range of the phase space compared to MD simulation, which couldbe treated as a rapid and efficient complement to MD trajectoriesfor studying RNA-protein interactions.
items.summary_zh: RPDynaFlow 采用原子级条件流匹配生成 RNA—蛋白复合物构象集合，并以 600 ns 分子动力学（MD）轨迹训练；摘要称其可扩展相较 MD 的相空间采样范围。
items.why_it_matters_zh: RNA—蛋白复合物的柔性与化学异质性长期限制构象建模，该模型为结构机制研究和结构导向设计提供了快速补充工具。训练和比较均依赖有限的 MD 轨迹，生成构象的物理真实性及实验一致性仍需更严格评估。
items.abstract_zh: 生物分子的构象集合是理解结构转变和药物设计的基础。深度学习生成模型已推进蛋白质和小分子构象集合生成，但由于 RNA 和蛋白质组分的化学异质性、数据集规模有限以及二者柔性尺度不同，RNA—蛋白复合物仍未得到解决。我们提出 RPDynaFlow，一种用于生成 RNA—蛋白复合物构象集合的流匹配模型，其训练数据为 600 ns 的分子动力学（MD）模拟轨迹。结果显示，与 MD 模拟相比，该模型扩展了相空间的采样范围，可作为研究 RNA—蛋白相互作用的 MD 轨迹的一种快速高效补充。
items.author_line: Li, Y., Lu, K.

items.title: A conserved serotonin receptor pathway is a druggable modifier of Tau pathology, neural circuit formation and neurodegeneration
items.abstract_or_text: Tauopathies are devastating neurodegenerative disorders characterized by Tau hyperphosphorylation, neurofibrillary tangle (NFT) formation, neuronal dysfunction, and cognitive decline. Here, we establish a new Drosophila tauopathy model expressing eGFP-tagged human TauWT or the disease-associated TauP301L variant in the nervous system. TauP301L expression recapitulates key pathological and behavioral hallmarks of tauopathy, including elevated Tau hyperphosphorylation, accumulation of NFT-like, pTau-positive assemblies in vivo, reduced lifespan, hyperactivity, sleep loss, progressive locomotor decline, and age-dependent brain degeneration. Strikingly, TauP301L also disrupts the architecture of the mushroom body, a learning- and memory-related circuit in Drosophila, revealing an early disruption of neural circuit formation that is distinct from adult neurodegenerative phenotypes. We further show that suppression of serotonin 5-HT7R-CDK5 signaling pathway, either by genetic knockdown or pharmacological inhibition with inverse agonist, rescues Tau-induced behavioral and anatomical phenotypes. These findings identify 5-HT7R signaling as a conserved and druggable modifier of Tau toxicity and establish this model as a powerful in vivo platform for mechanistic studies and therapeutic discovery in tauopathies.
items.summary_zh: 研究建立表达 eGFP 标记 human TauWT 或 TauP301L 的果蝇 tauopathy 模型，发现遗传敲低或反向激动剂药理抑制 5-HT7R-CDK5 通路可挽救 Tau 相关行为与解剖表型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 体内遗传与药理干预共同指向 5-HT7R 作为 Tau 毒性的可药物化调节因子，并提供了研究神经回路早期异常的平台。研究仍处于果蝇模型，向哺乳动物和患者的可转化性及反向激动剂的选择性须进一步确认。
items.abstract_zh: Tauopathy 是以 Tau 过度磷酸化、神经原纤维缠结（NFT）形成、神经元功能障碍和认知下降为特征的毁灭性神经退行性疾病。在此，我们建立了一种新的果蝇 tauopathy 模型，在神经系统中表达 eGFP 标记的 human TauWT 或疾病相关 TauP301L 变体。TauP301L 表达重现了 tauopathy 的关键病理和行为特征，包括升高的 Tau 过度磷酸化、体内 NFT 样 pTau 阳性聚集体的累积、寿命缩短、活动亢进、睡眠减少、进行性运动能力下降和随年龄加重的脑退化。引人注目的是，TauP301L 还破坏了果蝇蘑菇体这一与学习和记忆相关回路的结构，揭示了不同于成年神经退行性表型的神经回路形成早期异常。我们进一步表明，无论通过遗传敲低，还是利用反向激动剂进行药理抑制来抑制 serotonin 5-HT7R-CDK5 信号通路，均可挽救 Tau 诱导的行为和解剖表型。这些发现确定 5-HT7R 信号是 Tau 毒性的保守且可药物化调节因子，并将该模型确立为用于 tauopathy 机制研究和治疗发现的强大体内平台。
items.author_line: Tsap, M. I., Navrotska, V. V., Labus, J., Ponimaskin, E., Yatsenko, A. S., Shcherbata, H. R.

items.title: Synthesis and Optimization of a Nanoparticle Vaccine to Deliver Tumor-Associated Glycopeptide Immunogens Against Pancreatic Cancer
items.abstract_or_text: β-glucans are polymers of glucose, primarily with a 1,3- “beta” linkage at the anomeric center connection points. They are found in various forms in fungi, bacteria and cereals, and are known for their immune stimulant activity as well as being a source of essential fiber in the human diet. These polysaccharides have been employed in many experimental immunotherapeutic modalities as targeting agents to the protein Dectin-1 on Antigen Presenting Cells (APCs). We have previously synthesized gold nanoparticle coated with yeast β-glucans and functionalized with glycopeptide antigens from tumor-associated Mucin-4, a potential biomarker for pancreatic cancer, as a possible vaccine candidate against Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinomas (PDACs). In this report, we have refined this design to include β-glucans from different sources, designed a novel attachment point to covalently link antigen to the polysaccharide backbone and evaluated the cytokine response to treatment of RAW264.7 tumor macrophages with these new nanoparticles and found them to elicit an inflammatory antitumor response through the gene expression of TNF-a and IL-6. We also included a built-in cleavage site for protease release of antigen after endocytosis of these particles into an APCs. Future administration of these constructs into animals should provide a new and selective way of delivering tumor neoantigens to the immune system as a therapeutic vaccine against not only PDACs, but any cancer where glycopeptides from highly overexpressed tumor-associated surface proteins can be processed by adaptive immune surveillance.
items.summary_zh: 研究优化了以酵母 β-glucans 包覆、携带肿瘤相关 Mucin-4 glycopeptide antigen 的金纳米颗粒疫苗，并在 RAW264.7 肿瘤巨噬细胞中观察到 TNF-a 和 IL-6 基因表达介导的炎性抗肿瘤响应。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把糖聚合物靶向、共价抗原偶联和内吞后蛋白酶释放设计结合于同一纳米疫苗体系，具有肿瘤糖肽递送价值。现有验证限于细胞因子与基因表达读出，尚无动物免疫原性、疗效或安全性证据。
items.abstract_zh: β-glucans 是葡萄糖聚合物，主要在异头中心连接点处具有 1,3-“beta” 键。它们以多种形式存在于真菌、细菌和谷物中，既以免疫刺激活性著称，也是人类饮食中必需膳食纤维的来源。这些多糖已在多种实验性免疫治疗模式中被用作靶向 Antigen Presenting Cells（APCs）上蛋白 Dectin-1 的药剂。我们此前合成了由酵母 β-glucans 包覆、并以肿瘤相关 Mucin-4 的 glycopeptide antigens 功能化的金纳米颗粒，作为抗 Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinomas（PDACs）的潜在疫苗候选物。在本报告中，我们将设计改进为纳入不同来源的 β-glucans，设计了一个新的连接位点以将抗原共价连接到多糖骨架，并评价这些新纳米颗粒处理 RAW264.7 肿瘤巨噬细胞后的细胞因子响应；结果发现，它们可通过 TNF-a 和 IL-6 的基因表达引发炎性抗肿瘤响应。我们还加入了一个内置切割位点，使颗粒被 APCs 内吞后可由蛋白酶释放抗原。未来在动物中施用这些构建体，可能提供一种新的选择性方式，将肿瘤新抗原递送给免疫系统，作为不仅针对 PDACs，而且针对任何可由适应性免疫监视处理高度过表达肿瘤相关表面蛋白 glycopeptides 的癌症的治疗性疫苗。
items.author_line: John E. Chittum, Achyut Dahal, Joseph J. Barchi

items.title: Four numbers, one axis: deep learning models reveal what leaf spectrum constrains about Farquhar-von Caemmerer-Berry photosynthesis
items.abstract_or_text: Leaf reflectance spectra are emerging as a viable substitute for gas-exchange measurements of photosynthetic capacity, with a community benchmark reporting that a spectrum accurately recovers most Farquhar-von Caemmerer-Berry (FvCB) parameters. This study re-scores the recovery under dataset-blocked, species-blocked, and leave-one-dataset-out designs, measuring the split-half reliability of each curated parameter. We constructed a convolutional encoder that maps a spectrum to the four parameters through a fixed, differentiable FvCB decoder trained on measured assimilation. A conspecific of 97.4% of held-out leaves were present in the training set, and accuracy is lost along the dataset axis but not along the species axis. Under blocked evaluation, a spectrum constrains a single capacity axis. Jmax25 retains only 17% of its recovery when Vcmax25 is held constant, and the Jmax25:Vcmax25 ratio is not predicted above a median null. The curated values of TPU25 are not reproducible, whereas those of Rday25 are well determined, but its recovery fails due to the loss. The published study measures interpolation rather than transfer, and spectra constrain less of the FvCB parameter space than assumed, including the carboxylation to electron transport balance. Routing predictions through explicit biochemistry makes identifiability measurable, although it does not improve prediction accuracy.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以可微 FvCB 解码器和卷积编码器重新检验叶片反射光谱对光合作用参数的恢复能力，显示常见评测更接近插值；在按数据集留出时，光谱主要约束单一能力轴。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作以严格留出设计和显式生化模型检视遥感表型预测的可识别性，为光谱—生理模型的验证提供重要反例。其结论依赖现有整理数据和损失设计，仍需更多独立采样条件下的检验。
items.abstract_zh: 叶片反射光谱正成为气体交换测量光合能力的一种可行替代方案，一项社区基准报告称，一条光谱可准确恢复大部分 Farquhar-von Caemmerer-Berry（FvCB）参数。本研究在按数据集留出、按物种留出和留一数据集外推的设计下，重新评估这种恢复能力，并测量每个整理参数的半分可靠性。我们构建了一个卷积编码器，通过在实测同化作用上训练的固定、可微 FvCB 解码器，将光谱映射为四个参数。留出叶片中有 97.4%在训练集中存在同种个体；准确性沿数据集轴丢失，却不沿物种轴丢失。在留出评估下，一条光谱只约束单一能力轴。当 Vcmax25 保持恒定时，Jmax25 仅保留其恢复能力的 17%，且 Jmax25:Vcmax25 比值的预测未高于中位数空模型。整理后的 TPU25 数值不可复现，而 Rday25 数值确定性良好，但其恢复因损失函数而失败。已发表研究测量的是插值而非迁移，光谱对 FvCB 参数空间的约束少于既有假设，其中包括羧化与电子传递的平衡。通过显式生物化学路径传递预测使可识别性得以量化，尽管这并未提高预测准确性。
items.author_line: Ray, R., Maloof, J., Magney, T.

items.title: Bridging Food Chemistry and Computational Approaches with Agentic AI: Plant Protein Solubility and Bioactive-Enzyme Interactions
items.abstract_or_text: Computational approaches can provide valuable molecular-level and data-driven insights for food chemistry research, but their broader use remains limited by the need for specialized computational and programming expertise. In this study, we propose a human–AI collaborative framework that bridges food chemistry and computational approaches through simple, visible, step-by-step agentic AI workflow design. The framework enables food scientists to translate domain-specific hypotheses into computational workflows that can be planned, implemented, tested, refined, and reused with AI assistance. Two practical applications are presented. The first uses surface-based structural descriptors to investigate plant protein water solubility. Principal component analysis explained 94.19% of the total variance in the first two components and distinguished proteins with greater surface exposure of charged residues from those enriched in surface-exposed Asn/Gln or nonpolar residues, which may favor protein–protein interactions and lower water solubility. The second integrates AlphaFold 3-based structural prediction and MM/GBSA binding affinity estimation to investigate interactions between food-derived polyphenols and pancreatic lipase. The predicted binding-affinity ranking of quercetin > curcumin > resveratrol was consistent with reported enzymatic inhibition trends, while residue-level analysis suggested that hydrophobic contacts and interactions with catalytic residues, particularly Ser153, contribute to ligand stabilization near the catalytic region. Together, these examples demonstrate how food chemistry hypotheses can be translated into clear, traceable, and reusable agentic AI workflows, lowering technical barriers to computational food chemistry while supporting both task execution and computational learning.
items.summary_zh: 该工作提出人机协作的智能体式 AI 工作流，用表面结构描述符分析植物蛋白水溶性，并结合 AlphaFold 3 与 MM/GBSA 估算食源多酚—胰脂肪酶相互作用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将食品化学假设转译为可复用计算流程，有助于降低结构计算的使用门槛；quercetin > curcumin > resveratrol 的预测排序与已报道抑制趋势一致。两项案例仍以计算分析为主，MM/GBSA 的定量可靠性及其可推广性须结合直接实验验证判断。
items.abstract_zh: 计算方法可为食品化学研究提供有价值的分子层面和数据驱动见解，但其更广泛的应用仍受制于对专门计算与编程技能的需求。在本研究中，我们提出一个人机协作框架，通过简单、可见、逐步的智能体式 AI 工作流设计，连接食品化学与计算方法。该框架使食品科学家能够在 AI 协助下，将领域特定假设转化为可规划、实施、测试、改进和复用的计算工作流。文中给出两个实际应用。第一个应用采用基于表面的结构描述符研究植物蛋白水溶性。主成分分析中前两个成分解释了总方差的 94.19%，并区分出具有更多表面暴露带电残基的蛋白，与富含表面暴露 Asn/Gln 或非极性残基、可能更有利于蛋白—蛋白相互作用并降低水溶性的蛋白。第二个应用整合基于 AlphaFold 3 的结构预测和 MM/GBSA 结合亲和力估算，以研究食源多酚与胰脂肪酶的相互作用。预测的结合亲和力排序 quercetin > curcumin > resveratrol 与已报道的酶抑制趋势一致，残基水平分析表明，疏水接触以及与催化残基、尤其是 Ser153 的相互作用，有助于在催化区域附近稳定配体。总体而言，这些例子表明，食品化学假设可被转化为清晰、可追踪和可复用的智能体式 AI 工作流，在支持任务执行与计算学习的同时降低食品化学计算的技术门槛。
items.author_line: Xiping Gong, Yike Zhao, Madelyn M. Rippo, Hualu Zhou

items.title: Mapping Structured Absences in Scientific Papers: An Auditable LLM-Assisted Workflow Demonstrated on Cross-Coupling Chemistry
items.abstract_or_text: Scientific papers record what was discovered and communicated, but the resolution at which evidence relations are made explicit—a paper’s documentary resolution—often falls short of what later computational reuse, benchmarking, or data-driven synthesis requires. We present UQS (Unasked Question Structuring), an auditable LLM-assisted pipeline that takes scientific papers as input and produces structured absence records with evidence chains, an Evidence Pack (EP) dictionary specifying the evidence needed to reach the next evidential level, a bounded filling-status map across later literature under pre-locked criteria, and cross-paper research-question briefs. Applied to Kumada’s 1972 Ni-catalysed cross-coupling communication over a 54-year record window (1972–2026), UQS derives ten EPs and reveals a VQ-hierarchy inversion: methodology-level documentation is addressed early, whereas system-matched mechanistic documentation (VQ-3) appears only after 49 years (Mazet 2021), and quantitative-reliability documentation (VQ-4) remains a bounded non-detection—a pattern consistent with publication-incentive structure. The paper claims auditability, configuration-pinned rerun consistency, and internal robustness (four-model cross-comparison, N=6 multi-run aggregation); external expert validation is registered as future work.
items.summary_zh: UQS 是面向论文证据缺失的可审计 LLM 辅助流程；在 1972—2026 年 Kumada Ni-catalysed cross-coupling 文献中，它构建十个 Evidence Pack，并分析方法学、机制和定量可靠性证据的出现时序。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法为催化文献的机器复用、基准构建及研究空白表述提供可追溯框架，并明确记录其未检出结论的适用范围。当前仅展示单一历史案例，且外部专家验证仍计划进行，文献筛查标准对结果的影响值得持续关注。
items.abstract_zh: 科学论文记录了被发现和被传达的内容，但其中证据关系被明确表达的精细程度——一篇论文的文献记录精度——往往不足以满足后续计算复用、基准测试或数据驱动合成的要求。我们提出 UQS（Unasked Question Structuring），一种可审计的 LLM 辅助流程：它以科学论文为输入，生成带有证据链的结构化缺失记录、规定达到下一证据级别所需证据的 Evidence Pack（EP）词典、在预先固定标准下针对后续文献的限定范围填补状态图，以及跨论文研究问题简报。UQS 被应用于 Kumada 1972 年 Ni-catalysed cross-coupling 通讯在 54 年记录窗口（1972–2026）中的分析，得到十个 EP，并揭示了 VQ 层级倒置：方法学层面的文献记录很早得到补充，而系统匹配的机制文献记录（VQ-3）在 49 年后才出现（Mazet 2021），定量可靠性文献记录（VQ-4）仍是在限定范围内未检出的结果——这一模式与发表激励结构相符。本文声称具备可审计性、由配置固定的重运行一致性和内部稳健性（四模型交叉比较、N=6 多次运行汇总）；外部专家验证已登记为未来工作。
items.author_line: Yuriko Ono, Masaharu Yoshioka, Tetsuya Taketsugu

items.title: A reaction-diffusion framework for de novo Polycomb spreading
items.abstract_or_text: Eukaryotic organisms rely on post-translational modifications to chromatin to maintain stable patterns of gene silencing. These modifications include trimethylation at histone H3 lysine 27 (H3K27me3), which is deposited by Polycomb Repressive Complex 2 (PRC2) and accumulates on the genome during embryogenesis. While this process underlies the proper specification of cell types, we lack the ability to quantitatively predict the de novo establishment of Polycomb states. The kinetics of H3K27 methylation is difficult to quantify in vivo, and further, the network of molecular interactions that influences Polycomb states is complex. Here, leveraging the Drosophila embryonic system, we measure H3K27me3 dynamics with ChIP-seq and extract the rate the modification spreads along chromatin in vivo. To provide a mechanistic explanation for this rate, we build a reaction-diffusion framework that models how PRC2 establishes states of gene silencing de novo. The reaction-diffusion system recapitulates experimental observations in wild-type and mutant embryos, and suggests that PRC2 can diffuse in 1D along chromatin at a rate enhanced by Polycomb Repressive Complex 1. Through this work, we define a minimal set of parameters that dictate in vivo Polycomb dynamics, and provide evidence that the early embryo creates a super-charged environment for epigenetic modification.
items.summary_zh: 研究在果蝇胚胎中以 ChIP-seq 测量 H3K27me3 沿染色质传播的动力学，并构建 reaction-diffusion 模型复现野生型和突变体观测，提出 PRC1 可增强 PRC2 的一维扩散。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将体内动力学测量与最小机制模型结合，可定量研究 PRC2 建立基因沉默状态的过程，并为表观遗传药理研究提供参数化框架。结果来自果蝇早期胚胎，参数在其他发育阶段和物种中的适用性仍有待检验。
items.abstract_zh: 真核生物依赖染色质的翻译后修饰来维持稳定的基因沉默模式。这些修饰包括组蛋白 H3 第 27 位赖氨酸三甲基化（H3K27me3），其由 Polycomb Repressive Complex 2（PRC2）沉积，并在胚胎发生期间在基因组上累积。尽管这一过程是细胞类型正确指定的基础，我们仍缺乏定量预测 Polycomb 状态从头建立的能力。H3K27 甲基化动力学难以在体内定量，且影响 Polycomb 状态的分子相互作用网络十分复杂。在此，我们利用果蝇胚胎系统，以 ChIP-seq 测量 H3K27me3 动力学，并提取该修饰在体内沿染色质传播的速率。为对该速率作出机制解释，我们构建了一个 reaction-diffusion 框架，模拟 PRC2 如何从头建立基因沉默状态。该 reaction-diffusion 系统重现了野生型和突变胚胎中的实验观测，并提示 PRC2 可沿染色质进行一维扩散，其速率受到 Polycomb Repressive Complex 1 的增强。通过这项工作，我们界定了一组决定体内 Polycomb 动力学的最小参数，并提供证据表明早期胚胎形成了有利于表观遗传修饰的高活性环境。
items.author_line: Degen, E. A., Blythe, S. A.

items.title: From Reasoning to Pixels: Grounded Medical Multimodal LLMs for VQA and Segmentation
items.abstract_or_text: Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in Medical Visual Question Answering (Med-VQA), their reliance on global image features often lacks precise pixel-level grounding, thereby limiting clinical trustworthiness. To bridge the semantic gap between high-level clinical reasoning and spatial localization, we propose \textsc{MedREAL} (Medical REasoning-driven Answering and Localization), a unified framework that seamlessly aligns linguistic reasoning with spatial grounding. Specifically, MedREAL introduces Seg Anchored Reasoning Pooling (SARP) to distill task-relevant semantic evidence directly from [SEG] tokens within the MLLM's hidden states. Furthermore, a Reasoning-to-Visual (R2V) fusion mechanism is proposed to effectively inject these reasoning-aware features into a segmentation pipeline for accurate mask decoding. To facilitate this paradigm, we construct MedRAVS-13K, a comprehensive dataset comprising 13,824 expertly validated samples across four diverse imaging modalities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MedREAL significantly outperforms state-of-the-arts, achieving 68.49\% gIoU and 70.47\% cIoU on benchmark evaluations. By generating evidence masks that are strictly consistent with textual diagnoses, MedREAL provides a robust, interpretable framework for reasoning-driven medical image analysis.
items.summary_zh: MedREAL：用于医学 VQA 与分割的推理驱动像素级定位框架。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 以13,824个经专家验证的多模态样本连接诊断推理与分割掩膜，适合评估可解释医学影像模型；其临床价值仍需前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在医学视觉问答（Med-VQA）中展现出令人瞩目的性能，但其对全局图像特征的依赖往往缺少精确的像素级定位，因而限制了临床可信度。为弥合高层临床推理与空间定位之间的语义鸿沟，我们提出 MedREAL（Medical REasoning-driven Answering and Localization），一个将语言推理与空间定位无缝对齐的统一框架。具体而言，MedREAL 引入分割锚定推理池化（SARP），直接从 MLLM 隐藏状态中的 [SEG] tokens 提炼任务相关的语义证据。此外，我们提出推理到视觉（R2V）融合机制，将这些具备推理感知能力的特征有效注入分割流程，以实现精确的掩膜解码。为支撑这一范式，我们构建了 MedRAVS-13K，一个包含13,824个经专家验证样本的综合数据集，覆盖4种不同影像模态。大量实验表明，MedREAL 显著优于现有最佳方法，在基准评测中达到68.49% gIoU和70.47% cIoU。通过生成与文本诊断严格一致的证据掩膜，MedREAL 为推理驱动的医学图像分析提供了稳健且可解释的框架。
items.author_line: Haowen Gu, Gensheng Pei, Junzhu Mao, Qiong Wang, Mingwu Ren, Yazhou Yao

items.title: OmicsFM brings proteomics into the foundation model era
items.abstract_or_text: While foundation models have been shown to learn biological representations from large transcriptomic atlases, it remained unknown whether proteomics data allow the same. We here therefore introduce OmicsFM, a modality-agnostic transformer pretrained through masked abundance reconstruction on an unprecedented proteomics data corpus of 48,837 quality-filtered proteomics profiles from 1,397 reprocessed PRIDE projects. Interestingly, despite training on 14- to 93-fold fewer profiles than matched bulk- and single-cell transcriptomic models, respectively, our proteomics model rivals both. On held-out projects, OmicsFM attention networks recovered more molecular relationships than co-expression methods and existing single-cell foundation models across nine reference databases that reveal pathway-level organization. Sample-level embeddings preserved biological structure across independent studies, and its representations transferred successfully to cell-type classification, gene-essentiality prediction, and perturbation-response prediction, while consistently outperforming task-specific models. Moreover, our results show that proteomics and transcriptomics representations capture complementary biology. OmicsFM thus firmly establishes the possibility of training highly performant proteomics-based foundation models, and their importance in modelling and uncovering fundamental biology.
items.summary_zh: OmicsFM：以大规模再处理蛋白质组数据训练的模态无关 Transformer。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 48,837个蛋白质组谱和1,397个 PRIDE 项目的规模，使其成为蛋白质组基础模型的重要资源；跨项目与多任务迁移结果支持其方法价值。
items.abstract_zh: 基础模型已被证明可以从大规模转录组图谱中学习生物学表征，但蛋白质组数据能否实现同样效果仍不清楚。因此，我们提出 OmicsFM：一个通过掩蔽丰度重建预训练的模态无关 Transformer，训练数据为前所未有的蛋白质组语料库，其中包括来自1,397个经再处理 PRIDE 项目的48,837个经质量筛选蛋白质组谱。有趣的是，尽管训练所用谱数分别比匹配的 bulk 和单细胞转录组模型少14至93倍，我们的蛋白质组模型仍可与二者相媲美。在留出项目上，OmicsFM 注意力网络在9个揭示通路层级组织的参考数据库中，恢复出的分子关系多于共表达方法和现有单细胞基础模型。样本层面的嵌入在独立研究间保留了生物学结构，其表征还成功迁移至细胞类型分类、基因必需性预测和扰动反应预测，并持续优于任务专用模型。此外，我们的结果表明蛋白质组与转录组表征捕捉到互补的生物学信息。因此，OmicsFM 有力证明了可训练高性能的蛋白质组基础模型，以及这类模型在建模和揭示基础生物学中的重要性。
items.author_line: Heyndrickx, S., Gabriels, R., Ramadasan, H., Martens, L., Claeys, T.

items.title: Decoding Radiation-Induced Transcriptomic Signatures of Human Leukocytes using Long-Read RNA-Seq: Clinical and Biodosimetric Implications
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Gene expression profiling in radiation-exposed blood is a valuable tool for biodosimetry and clinical research. Evaluating the blood's transcriptomic radiation response provides insight into absorbed dose, hematotoxicities, and immune reactions. However, detailed analysis using long-read RNA sequencing is currently limited in its diffusion, despite the potential additional insights that could be extracted, including novel isoform discovery and on-the-field gene expression studies, owing to its portability. Results: In this study, we utilized Oxford Nanopore Technologies' long-read RNA sequencing on human peripheral blood leukocytes from three healthy donors 6 hours after exposure of whole peripheral blood to 4 Gy of X-rays. Compared to sham-irradiated (0 Gy) blood samples, gene-level differential expression analysis identified 117 upregulated and 66 downregulated genes, including canonical DNA damage repair and inflammatory responses. At the transcript level, 102 transcripts were significantly upregulated, and 17 were downregulated, revealing isoform-specific regulation that was not captured at the gene level. Notably, IL32, which was not detected as significantly changed at the gene level, exhibited significant upregulation of two transcript isoforms (log2 fold-changes of 1.19 and 1.99), while WDR74, ITM2B, AK2, and RPS19 displayed changes in transcript usage following irradiation. Leveraging long-read RNA sequencing, we further identified novel candidate isoforms, including protein-coding isoforms of PHPT1 and FBXO22 as well as non-coding candidates. Notably, the FBXO22 isoform showed evidence of altered protein domain architecture relative to the reference isoform. Conclusions: This study is the first to systematically investigate differential transcript usage in the leukocyte fraction of irradiated human whole blood using long-read RNA sequencing. We confirmed known radiation-response signatures at the gene level and identified isoform-level transcriptomic changes, including several isoforms that were undetectable in our previously generated matched short-read dataset. These findings demonstrate the potential of long-read RNA sequencing to provide a more detailed view of radiation-induced transcriptomic alterations, with potential applications in biodosimetry and clinical settings.
items.summary_zh: 采用长读长 RNA-Seq 解析人白细胞辐射诱导的转录组和异构体变化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究在3名健康供体的离体全血样本中获得异构体层面信号，为辐射生物剂量评估研究提供候选读出，但样本量有限且并非临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：辐射暴露血液的基因表达谱分析是生物剂量评估和临床研究的宝贵工具。评估血液的转录组辐射反应能够揭示吸收剂量、血液毒性和免疫反应。然而，尽管长读长 RNA 测序具有便携性，并可能带来包括新异构体发现和现场基因表达研究在内的额外见解，其详细分析目前应用仍有限。结果：本研究使用 Oxford Nanopore Technologies 的长读长 RNA 测序，对3名健康供体全外周血经4 Gy X 射线照射6小时后获得的人外周血白细胞进行分析。与假照射（0 Gy）血液样本相比，基因层面的差异表达分析识别出117个上调和66个下调基因，其中包括经典的 DNA 损伤修复和炎症反应。在转录本层面，102个转录本显著上调，17个显著下调，揭示出基因层面未能捕捉到的异构体特异性调控。值得注意的是，IL32 在基因层面未被检测为显著变化，但其两个转录本异构体显著上调，log2 fold-changes 分别为1.19和1.99；而 WDR74、ITM2B、AK2 和 RPS19 在辐射后表现出转录本使用变化。利用长读长 RNA 测序，我们还识别出新的候选异构体，包括 PHPT1 和 FBXO22 的蛋白编码异构体以及非编码候选异构体。值得注意的是，与参考异构体相比，FBXO22 异构体显示出蛋白结构域架构改变的证据。结论：本研究首次系统考察了利用长读长 RNA 测序分析受辐射人全血白细胞组分中差异转录本使用的情况。我们在基因层面确认了已知辐射反应特征，并识别出异构体层面的转录组变化，其中包括在我们此前生成的匹配短读长数据集中未被检测到的若干异构体。这些发现表明，长读长 RNA 测序有望更细致地呈现辐射诱导的转录组改变，并可能应用于生物剂量评估和临床场景。
items.author_line: Salah, A., Schmidberger, H., Marini, F., Zahnreich, S.

items.title: Normative modelling of cortical networks identifies subtypes of type 2 diabetes associated with distinct clinical and transcriptomic profiles
items.abstract_or_text: Type 2 diabetes (T2D) is characterized by substantial clinical heterogeneity, yet its neurobiological substrates remain unclear. Here, we leverage normative modelling of cortical morphometric networks to quantify individual-level brain deviations using structural MRI data from 3,723 participants (1,941 T2D patients and 1,782 healthy controls) across three independent cohorts. Data-driven clustering reveals two robust T2D biotypes characterized by widespread positive (biotype 1) and negative (biotype 2) brain deviations. Despite comparable overall metabolic burdens, these biotypes feature distinct brain-metabolic coupling patterns: biotype 1 is primarily associated with lipid metabolism, whereas biotype 2 reflects a multifactorial metabolic burden spanning glycaemic control, adiposity, lipid, vascular risks, and disease duration. These divergent brain vulnerability profiles have distinct cognitive consequences; notably, biotype 2 shows poorer performance in complex cognitive tasks, aligning with negatively deviated connectivity gradients along the sensorimotor-to-association axis. Spatial transcriptomic analyses further link biotype 2 deviations to gene expression patterns enriched in insulin signalling, mitochondrial functions, tight junctions, and neurodegenerative disease pathways, alongside specific involvement of inhibitory neurons and oligodendrocyte lineage cells. Our findings provide a neurobiological understanding of T2D heterogeneity and establish a data-driven framework for characterizing personalized brain vulnerability, with implications for advancing precision diabetes medicine.
items.summary_zh: 用皮层网络常模建模识别2型糖尿病的脑部异质性亚型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 3个独立队列中的3,723名参与者将结构 MRI、临床表型和空间转录组联系起来；结论描述相关模式，尚不能证明糖尿病造成相应脑改变。
items.abstract_zh: 2型糖尿病（T2D）具有显著的临床异质性，但其神经生物学基础仍不清楚。我们在此利用皮层形态测量网络的常模建模，使用来自3个独立队列的3,723名参与者（1,941名 T2D 患者和1,782名健康对照）的结构 MRI 数据，量化个体层面的脑偏离。数据驱动聚类揭示出两种稳健的 T2D 生物亚型：亚型1具有广泛的正向脑偏离，亚型2具有广泛的负向脑偏离。尽管总体代谢负担相近，这两种亚型呈现不同的脑-代谢耦合模式：亚型1主要与脂质代谢有关，而亚型2反映了涵盖血糖控制、脂肪量、脂质、血管风险和病程的多因素代谢负担。这些不同的脑脆弱性谱具有不同的认知后果；尤其是亚型2在复杂认知任务中的表现较差，这与感觉运动至联合区轴上负向偏离的连接梯度相一致。空间转录组分析进一步将亚型2的偏离与富集于胰岛素信号、线粒体功能、紧密连接和神经退行性疾病通路的基因表达模式联系起来，并提示抑制性神经元和少突胶质细胞谱系的特异参与。我们的发现为理解 T2D 异质性提供了神经生物学视角，并建立了表征个体化脑脆弱性的数据驱动框架，有助于推进精准糖尿病医学。

items.title: Extracellular Vesicles Derived from L-MYC Neural Stem Cells Mediate Neuroprotection in 3D Models of Chemotherapy- and Radiation-Induced Neurotoxicity
items.abstract_or_text: Background/Objectives: Cancer survivors frequently experience long-term neurocognitive impairments following chemotherapy and cranial irradiation, yet experimental models that enable mechanistic investigation of therapy-induced neurotoxicity at the transcriptional level remain limited. This study aimed to develop a human three-dimensional (3D) neural tissue model derived from L-Myc immortalized neural stem cells (LMNSCs) and use transcriptomic profiling to identify molecular pathways underlying chemotherapy- and radiation-induced neural injury and extracellular vesicle (EV)-mediated recovery. Methods: LMNSCs were differentiated in a 3D, methylcellulose-based culture to generate neural tissue containing neurons, astrocytes, and oligodendrocytes. Cultures were exposed to methotrexate (MTX) or ionizing radiation to induce neural injury and subsequently treated with LMNSC-derived EVs. Neural injury and repair mechanisms were evaluated by immunocytochemistry and bulk transcriptomics. Results: MTX and irradiation induced dose-dependent injury, exhibited by loss of neuronal complexity and reduced glial populations. LMNSC-EV treatment promoted recovery of neuronal and glial populations following MTX- and irradiation-induced injury. Transcriptomic analysis of irradiated cultures revealed activation of inflammation, DNA damage, and stress-response pathways, which were attenuated after treatment with LMNSC-EVs. Conclusions: LMNSC-based 3D neural tissue provides a human-relevant platform for modeling cancer therapy-induced neurotoxicity. Furthermore, LMNSC-EVs represent a promising cell-free regenerative therapeutic that restores injury-associated inflammatory, stress, and metabol-ic transcriptional programs after radiation-induced neural injury.
items.summary_zh: L-MYC 神经干细胞来源细胞外囊泡在3D神经组织模型中缓解治疗相关神经损伤。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 人源3D神经组织、转录组和免疫细胞化学共同评估 MTX 与辐射损伤，为细胞外囊泡修复机制研究提供实验平台；尚非人体疗效证据。
items.abstract_zh: 背景/目的：癌症幸存者在化疗和颅脑照射后常出现长期神经认知损害，但能够在转录层面开展治疗诱导神经毒性机制研究的实验模型仍然有限。本研究旨在开发一种源自 L-Myc 永生化神经干细胞（LMNSCs）的人源三维（3D）神经组织模型，并利用转录组分析识别化疗和辐射诱导神经损伤及细胞外囊泡（EV）介导恢复的分子通路。方法：在以甲基纤维素为基础的3D培养体系中诱导 LMNSCs 分化，生成含神经元、星形胶质细胞和少突胶质细胞的神经组织。培养物经甲氨蝶呤（MTX）或电离辐射处理以诱导神经损伤，随后以 LMNSC 来源 EV 处理。通过免疫细胞化学和 bulk 转录组学评估神经损伤与修复机制。结果：MTX 和照射均诱导剂量依赖性损伤，表现为神经元复杂度丧失和胶质细胞群减少。LMNSC-EV 治疗促进 MTX 和照射诱导损伤后神经元与胶质细胞群的恢复。对受照射培养物的转录组分析显示，炎症、DNA 损伤和应激反应通路被激活，而经 LMNSC-EV 处理后这些通路减弱。结论：基于 LMNSC 的3D神经组织为癌症治疗诱导神经毒性建模提供了与人类相关的平台。此外，LMNSC-EVs 是一种有前景的无细胞再生治疗手段，可在辐射诱导神经损伤后恢复与损伤相关的炎症、应激和代谢转录程序。

items.title: CIViC-Fact: a proof-of-concept framework for AI-assisted verification of cancer variant interpretations
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate interpretation of genomic variants is critical for precision oncology but remains slow and dependent on specialized expertise. Public knowledgebases such as the Clinical Interpretation of Variants in Cancer (CIViC) help by curating literature-backed variant interpretations in a structured form, yet verification and review have become major bottlenecks. Large language models (LLMs) offer a potential mechanism for accelerating biomedical claim verification, but their rapid turnover, variable availability, and known risks of unsupported reasoning require standardized and reproducible evaluation before integration into curation workflows. To address this, we developed CIViC-Fact, an expert-curated, full-text benchmark and evaluation framework. Domain experts linked structured cancer-variant claims to sentence-level evidence from source publications, including evidence from full-text articles, tables, and non-abstract sections that are commonly omitted from existing biomedical question-answering and scientific fact-checking datasets. Claim-verification reference labels were derived from CIViC records, revision histories and controlled data augmentation. A major finding of CIViC-Fact is that abstracts are insufficient for realistic biomedical claim verification. In the evaluated development subset of text-verifiable entries with full-text access, fewer than 30% could be fully validated from the abstract alone, highlighting the importance of full-text evaluation for biomedical curation. Upon the application of our fact-checking pipeline to newly submitted CIViC entries, after excluding entries requiring supplementary material or images for validation, automated retrieval successfully identified appropriate evidence for most cases (93%), supporting low-incremental-effort evaluation of future systems. Fine-tuning improved agreement with CIViC-Fact reference labels on the static benchmark, but larger general-purpose models performed better on a heterogeneous post-cutoff cohort. These findings support CIViC-Fact primarily as a reproducible framework for comparing evolving retrieval and verification systems rather than as validation of a single deployment-ready model. These findings suggest that, in a rapidly changing model landscape, the durable contribution is not a single optimized model but a reproducible benchmark framework that enables continual testing, model substitution, and lightweight updating through small high-quality few-shot exemplar sets.
items.summary_zh: CIViC-Fact：辅助核验癌症变异解读的专家标注全文基准与评估框架。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架将癌症变异主张关联至句子级全文证据，并显示摘要通常不足以完成核验，可为不断变化的生物医学检索与验证系统提供可复现比较。
items.abstract_zh: 对基因组变异的准确解读对精准肿瘤学至关重要，但仍然缓慢且依赖专业知识。Clinical Interpretation of Variants in Cancer（CIViC）等公共知识库通过以结构化形式整理有文献支持的变异解读提供帮助，但核验和审查已成为主要瓶颈。大语言模型（LLMs）可能加速生物医学主张核验，但其快速迭代、可用性差异和已知的无依据推理风险，要求在纳入整理工作流程前进行标准化且可复现的评估。为此，我们开发了 CIViC-Fact，一个由领域专家整理的全文基准和评估框架。领域专家将结构化癌症变异主张关联至源论文中的句子级证据，其中包括全文文章、表格及非摘要部分的证据；这些内容通常被现有生物医学问答和科学事实核查数据集遗漏。CIViC-Fact 的一项主要发现是，摘要不足以完成真实的生物医学主张核验。在具有全文访问权限且可由文本核验的条目的评估开发子集中，少于30%的条目可仅凭摘要得到完整核验，凸显了全文评估对生物医学整理的重要性。将我们的事实核查流程应用于新提交的 CIViC 条目时，在排除需要补充材料或图像才能核验的条目后，自动检索在大多数情形（93%）中成功识别出适当证据，支持以较低增量工作量评估未来系统。微调提高了静态基准上与 CIViC-Fact 参考标签的一致性，但较大的通用模型在异质的截止日期后队列中表现更好。这些发现主要支持将 CIViC-Fact 用作比较不断演进的检索与验证系统的可复现框架，而非证明某一单一模型已可直接部署。在快速变化的模型环境中，持久贡献并非某一个经优化模型，而是能通过少量高质量少样本示例持续测试、替换模型并轻量更新的可复现基准框架。

items.title: Design and Assembly of Combinatorial DNA Barcodes for Probe-based Genomics Applications
items.abstract_or_text: Probe-based genomics technologies are extending molecular analysis into intact tissues and fixed cells, yet strategies to decode complex experimental conditions encoded in cellular RNA remain limited. Here we present a modular framework that integrates custom software tools with purpose-built cloning reagents to design, assemble, validate, and deploy combinatorial DNA barcodes. Combinatorial barcodes comprise spatially adjacent collections of known sequences, enabling millions of unique molecules to be efficiently distinguished using a limited set of probes. Our software tools integrate with optimized assembly plasmids and whole plasmid long-read sequencing for high-fidelity construction and structural validation of diverse combinatorial barcode architectures. Assembled barcode libraries are flexibly transferred into user-modified expression vectors to support diverse downstream experimental applications. We showcase the versatility of this framework by assembling two structurally distinct combinatorial barcode libraries, each containing millions of unique sequences. Following rabies virus-based delivery to the mouse brain, we validate in vivo decoding of a combinatorial barcode architecture capable of distinguishing ~16.3 million expressed RNAs through probe-based in situ sequencing. Our framework for flexible and accurate combinatorial barcode construction fills a technically demanding niche delivering cost-effective molecular reagents for multiplexed experimentation on current and evolving probe-based genomics platforms.
items.summary_zh: 用于探针基因组学的组合式 DNA 条形码设计、组装与验证框架。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 框架结合软件、克隆试剂和全质粒长读长测序，在小鼠脑内验证约1,630万条表达 RNA 的原位解码，扩展了高通量空间实验的编码能力。
items.abstract_zh: 基于探针的基因组学技术正将分子分析扩展至完整组织和固定细胞，但对细胞 RNA 中编码的复杂实验条件进行解码的策略仍然有限。我们提出一个模块化框架，将定制软件工具与专门设计的克隆试剂整合，用于设计、组装、验证和部署组合式 DNA 条形码。组合式条形码由空间相邻的已知序列集合构成，能够利用有限数量的探针高效区分数百万个独特分子。我们的软件工具与优化的组装质粒及全质粒长读长测序相结合，可高保真构建并进行结构验证多种组合式条形码架构。组装后的条形码文库可灵活转入用户修改的表达载体，以支持多样的下游实验应用。我们通过组装两个结构不同的组合式条形码文库展示该框架的通用性，每个文库均包含数百万条独特序列。通过基于狂犬病病毒向小鼠脑内递送，我们在体内验证了对一种组合式条形码架构的解码：该架构可通过基于探针的原位测序区分约1,630万条表达 RNA。我们用于灵活且准确构建组合式条形码的框架填补了一项技术要求很高的需求，可为当前和不断发展的探针基因组学平台上的多重实验提供经济高效的分子试剂。

items.title: Precision-cut liver slices as a model for evaluating therapeutic agents against hepatitis B and delta viruses
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Developing new therapeutic strategies against hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis delta virus (HDV) is essential to cure these infections. Yet evaluation of host-targeting agents (HTAs) with in vitro/in vivo models remains challenging. Therefore, we assessed precision-cut liver slices (PCLS) as an HBV/HDV co-infection model to study virus-host interactions and HTAs. Methods: We generated PCLS from human liver resections and infected them ex vivo with HBV and HDV. Tissue viability and architecture were monitored by intracellular ATP, secreted albumin, and multiplexed immunofluorescence. Viral markers were assessed by quantitative PCR, western blot, and light-sheet microscopy in infected slices following treatment with a sodium taurocholate co-transporting polypeptide (NTCP)-targeting peptide, lonafarnib, or the Toll-like receptor 8 agonist selgantolimod (SLGN). Single-cell RNA sequencing was performed to characterize the cellular responses to SLGN. Results: Here we show that our ex vivo infection protocol allows the establishment of HBV and HDV infection within the liver's three-dimensional architecture. Treatment with three well-characterized HTAs produced distinct antiviral effects consistent with each mechanism: an NTCP-targeting peptide blocked entry; lonafarnib induced intracellular hepatitis delta antigen accumulation; SLGN showed anti-HBV activity not previously seen in cultured hepatocytes, indicating cross-talk between immune and infected cells within liver slices. Conclusion: These results provide the characterization of PCLS as an ex vivo model of HBV/HDV co-infection and antiviral testing. In the future, PCLS could contribute to expediting pre-clinical characterization of HTAs and to exploring alternatives to animal experimentation.
items.summary_zh: 以精准切割肝片建立 HBV/HDV 共感染与宿主靶向抗病毒药物评估模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 人肝切除标本来源的离体3D模型配合单细胞 RNA 测序，可观察培养肝细胞中未显现的免疫相关效应，为临床前抗病毒研究增加可用体系。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：开发针对乙型肝炎病毒（HBV）和丁型肝炎病毒（HDV）的新治疗策略对于治愈这些感染至关重要。然而，使用体外/体内模型评估宿主靶向药物（HTAs）仍具挑战。因此，我们评估精准切割肝片（PCLS）作为 HBV/HDV 共感染模型，用于研究病毒-宿主相互作用和 HTAs。方法：我们由人肝切除标本制备 PCLS，并在离体条件下以 HBV 和 HDV 感染。通过细胞内 ATP、分泌白蛋白和多重免疫荧光监测组织活性与结构。对感染肝片使用靶向钠依赖性牛磺胆酸共转运多肽（NTCP）的肽、lonafarnib 或 Toll-like receptor 8 激动剂 selgantolimod（SLGN）治疗后，采用定量 PCR、western blot 和光片显微镜评估病毒标志物。开展单细胞 RNA 测序以描述对 SLGN 的细胞反应。结果：我们显示，该离体感染方案能够在肝脏三维结构中建立 HBV 和 HDV 感染。三种特征明确的 HTAs 治疗产生了与各自机制一致的不同抗病毒效应：靶向 NTCP 的肽阻断进入；lonafarnib 诱导细胞内 hepatitis delta antigen 积累；SLGN 显示出在培养肝细胞中此前未观察到的抗 HBV 活性，提示肝片内免疫细胞与受感染细胞之间存在相互作用。结论：这些结果完成了对 PCLS 作为 HBV/HDV 共感染和抗病毒测试离体模型的表征。未来，PCLS 可帮助加快 HTAs 的临床前表征，并探索动物实验的替代方案。

items.title: Phase separation behavior of TDP-43 governs its protein interactome and regulation of alternative splicing
items.abstract_or_text: TDP-43 is a nuclear RNA-binding protein that regulates RNA metabolism, including alternative splicing. Its aggregation is a major pathological hallmark of several neurodegenerative diseases. TDP-43 undergoes phase separation (PS) and this condensation behavior may be linked to aggregate formation. Whether and how PS governs TDP-43 RNA regulatory functions remains poorly understood. Here we utilized rationally designed mutations in the TDP-43 low complexity domain to tune TDP-43 PS, yielding a panel of TDP-43 variants with reduced propensity to form condensates (PS-deficient), and a panel forming irreversible, undynamic condensates (solid-like) in vitro and in cells. Two complementary interactomics approaches identified PS-dependent interactions between TDP-43 and key RNA regulatory factors, including splicing regulators and the RNA helicase UPF1, which show increased interactions with solid-like variants. Our results highlight that TDP-43 PS regulates RNA and protein homeostasis by modulating a subset of TDP-43-dependent alternative splicing events and by reshaping interactions with RNA regulatory factors.
items.summary_zh: TDP-43 相分离状态塑造蛋白互作组并调控可变剪接。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 理性突变、互作组学和细胞实验将凝聚体物性与 RNA 调控联系起来，为神经退行性疾病相关 TDP-43 生物学提供机制线索。
items.abstract_zh: TDP-43 是一种核内 RNA 结合蛋白，调控包括可变剪接在内的 RNA 代谢。其聚集是若干神经退行性疾病的主要病理标志。TDP-43 会发生相分离（PS），这种凝聚行为可能与聚集形成相关。PS 是否以及如何调控 TDP-43 的 RNA 调控功能，仍知之甚少。我们在此利用经理性设计的 TDP-43 低复杂度结构域突变来调节 TDP-43 PS，得到一组形成凝聚体倾向降低的 TDP-43 变体（PS-deficient），以及一组在体外和细胞中形成不可逆、无动态凝聚体的变体（solid-like）。两种互补的互作组学方法识别出 TDP-43 与关键 RNA 调控因子之间依赖 PS 的相互作用，其中包括剪接调控因子和 RNA 解旋酶 UPF1；这些因子与 solid-like 变体的相互作用增加。我们的结果强调，TDP-43 PS 通过调节一部分依赖 TDP-43 的可变剪接事件，并重塑与 RNA 调控因子的相互作用，调控 RNA 和蛋白稳态。

items.title: FuncSeek: Multi-PLM contrastive learning for protein functional similarity search
items.abstract_or_text: Below 30% pairwise sequence identity, alignment-based methods struggle to reliably distinguish true homologs from chance, and enzyme function prediction degrades accordingly: on proteins in this regime, even advanced methods (CLEAN) achieves only 55.1% accuracy at full EC specificity on the CARE benchmark. To this end Protein Language Models (PLMs) have gained favor as alternatives. However, PLMs often encode only a subset of the biology, whereas the understanding of enzyme function requires among other things a combination of sequence, structure and functional-context simultaneously. In this work, we describe FuncSeek, a contrastive learning model which utilizes three diverse, complementary PLMs: ESM2 (to model evolutionary co-variation), ProstT5 (for bilingual sequence and structure embeddings), and ProteinBERT (for functional semantic similarities). Using SwissProt data, these 2816-D embeddings are labelled with Enzyme Commission numbers (EC) and are trained through a supervised contrastive head into a 256-D space. FuncSeek attains 64.6% nearest-neighbour EC4 accuracy on the CARE out-of-distribution benchmark set (ood30; proteins below 30% identity to training set), outperforming CLEAN (55.1%) and Diamond BLASTp (51.4%), and obtains 93.7% nearest-neighbour EC4 accuracy on the promiscuous, multi-functional enzymes benchmark (CLEAN, 69.4%). We also show that the learned representations transfer without retraining to the TrEMBL database, achieving 97.3% nearest-neighbour EC4 accuracy on an 8,031 BRENDA-validated enzyme set, never seen during training. Because only projected embeddings are stored in the target index, and function is inferred from an annotated reference set, we propose this paradigm for rapidly searching extremely large metagenomic databases, bypassing costly sequence alignment and annotation pipelines.
items.summary_zh: FuncSeek：融合多个蛋白语言模型的蛋白功能相似性检索方法。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在低于30%序列同一性的 OOD 蛋白上报告优于 CLEAN 和 Diamond BLASTp 的 EC4 检索准确率，并在独立 BRENDA 验证酶集上测试迁移性。
items.abstract_zh: 当成对序列同一性低于30%时，基于比对的方法难以可靠地区分真实同源物与偶然相似，因此酶功能预测也会退化：在此类蛋白上，即便是先进方法 CLEAN 在 CARE 基准的完整 EC 特异性任务中也仅达到55.1%的准确率。为此，蛋白语言模型（PLMs）已成为替代方案。然而，PLMs 往往只编码生物学的一部分，而理解酶功能还需要同时结合序列、结构和功能情境等信息。在本研究中，我们描述 FuncSeek：一个对比学习模型，利用三个多样且互补的 PLMs，即 ESM2（建模进化共变）、ProstT5（用于双语序列和结构嵌入）和 ProteinBERT（用于功能语义相似性）。使用 SwissProt 数据，这些2,816-D 嵌入以酶学委员会编号（EC）标注，并经监督式对比学习头训练至256-D 空间。FuncSeek 在 CARE 域外基准集（ood30；训练集同一性低于30%的蛋白）上达到64.6%的最近邻 EC4 准确率，超过 CLEAN（55.1%）和 Diamond BLASTp（51.4%）；在具有多重功能的酶基准上，其最近邻 EC4 准确率达到93.7%（CLEAN 为69.4%）。我们还显示，所学习表征无需重新训练即可迁移至 TrEMBL 数据库，在训练中从未出现的8,031个经 BRENDA 验证酶构成的数据集上达到97.3%的最近邻 EC4 准确率。由于目标索引仅存储投影后的嵌入，且功能由注释参考集推断，我们提出这一范式可用于快速搜索极大规模宏基因组数据库，绕过高成本的序列比对和注释流程。
items.author_line: Cloete, L. J., Patterton, H. G.

items.title: Computer Vision for Real-Time Pixel-Level Anatomical Segmentation in Neurosurgery: First-in-Human Clinical Evaluation and Iterative Development (IDEAL Stage 1)
items.abstract_or_text: Introduction: Precise anatomical navigation is fundamental to safe endoscopic pituitary surgery, a high-stakes procedure characterised by a challenging learning curve. While traditional navigation systems often rely on workflow-disrupting probes or static preoperative imaging, advancements in computer vision AI (CVAI) now enable dynamic, real-time pixel-level anatomical segmentation directly from live surgical video. Our group has previously conducted a series of preclinical human-computer interaction studies to refine the system's design, alongside digital and high-fidelity physical simulations demonstrating the benefit of AI assistance in improving overall performance, training, and safety4-8. Building on this foundation, the current study represents a first-in-human application of real-time pixel-level CVAI anatomical segmentation in the neurosurgical operating room, serving to assess feasibility and to iteratively improve the system. Method: Guided by DECIDE-AI and IDEAL frameworks, this single-centre evaluation comprises an initial proof-of-concept phase (n=6) for endoscopic transsphenoidal pituitary surgeries. The AI model utilised a DINOv3-derived vision transformer architecture, deployed via a high-performance edge computing unit to achieve low-latency, real-time inference without reliance on cloud infrastructure. Feasibility and functionality were assessed via structured questionnaire, prospective observation, and blinded retrospective review of the recordings of the endoscopic surgical video feed and wider operating room environment. Continuous multi-stakeholder feedback through validated human factors surveys drove iterative technical refinements between cases. Results: Eight patients with pituitary adenomas were enrolled. The CVAI system was successfully deployed in six cases, demonstrating acceptable real-time pixel-level sella segmentation accuracy. Deployment failed pre-operatively in two cases owing to a single recurring system reboot bug. Iterative refinement between cases were driven by our experience and surgical team feedback. This resulted in the integration of additional anatomical structure segmentations (e.g., carotid arteries), enhanced model accuracy via training dataset expansion, and hardware firmware upgrades. Multi-stakeholder surveys demonstrated satisfactory system feasibility, usability, and acceptability among the surgical team. Both prospective observation and retrospective video review confirmed the absence of adverse events, including no significant distraction to the primary surgeon, and there were no AI-related clinical complications. Conclusion: This first-in-human early clinical evaluation demonstrates the feasibility and iterative development of real-time pixel-level CVAI-based anatomical navigation during high-stakes neurosurgery. Future work will include a larger single-centre case series (IDEAL Stage 2a) with more surgical teams to further iterate the system and explore its impact on safety, training and workflow. As the underpinning AI models improve and integrate with other intra-operative navigational technologies, such tools will likely be the cornerstone of intra-operative surgical decision support systems.
items.summary_zh: 实时像素级神经外科解剖分割的首次人体早期临床可行性评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究报告8名垂体腺瘤患者、其中6例成功部署，采用前瞻性观察和盲法回顾；无 AI 相关并发症的结果仅支持早期可行性。
items.abstract_zh: 引言：精确的解剖导航是安全开展内镜垂体手术的基础；这是一种高风险且学习曲线陡峭的操作。传统导航系统往往依赖干扰工作流程的探针或静态术前影像，而计算机视觉 AI（CVAI）的进展如今可直接从实时手术视频中实现动态、实时的像素级解剖分割。我们团队此前已开展一系列临床前人机交互研究以完善系统设计，并通过数字和高保真实体模拟展示 AI 辅助在改善整体表现、培训和安全方面的作用。基于这一基础，本研究代表实时像素级 CVAI 解剖分割在神经外科手术室中的首次人体应用，用于评估可行性并迭代改进系统。方法：在 DECIDE-AI 和 IDEAL 框架指导下，这项单中心评估包括内镜经蝶垂体手术的初始概念验证阶段（n=6）。AI 模型采用源自 DINOv3 的视觉 Transformer 架构，通过高性能边缘计算单元部署，以实现不依赖云基础设施的低延迟实时推理。通过结构化问卷、前瞻性观察以及对内镜手术视频流和更广泛手术室环境录像的盲法回顾，评估可行性和功能性。来自多方利益相关者的持续反馈通过经过验证的人因调查驱动病例间的迭代技术改进。结果：共纳入8名垂体腺瘤患者。CVAI 系统在6例中成功部署，显示出可接受的实时像素级蝶鞍分割准确性。由于一个反复出现的系统重启错误，2例在术前部署失败。病例间的迭代改进由我们的经验和手术团队反馈驱动，结果整合了额外解剖结构分割，例如颈动脉；并通过扩展训练数据集提升模型准确性、升级硬件固件。多方利益相关者调查显示，手术团队对系统的可行性、可用性和可接受性评价满意。前瞻性观察和回顾性视频审查均确认未发生不良事件，包括未对主刀医生产生显著干扰，也未出现 AI 相关临床并发症。结论：这项首次人体早期临床评估表明，在高风险神经外科中使用基于 CVAI 的实时像素级解剖导航具有可行性，并支持其迭代开发。后续工作将开展包含更多手术团队的较大单中心病例系列（IDEAL Stage 2a），以进一步迭代系统并探索其对安全性、培训和工作流程的影响。随着底层 AI 模型改进并与其他术中导航技术整合，这类工具很可能成为术中手术决策支持系统的核心组成部分。

items.title: FOCUS-3D: Robust, generalizable volumetric cell segmentation for three-dimensional fluorescence microscopy
items.abstract_or_text: Understanding how cells establish spatial organization within tissues is a fundamental question in life sciences. While modern three-dimensional fluorescence microscopy captures large-volume tissue architecture, extracting quantitative cellular insights from complex volumetric datasets remains a major barrier. Here, we introduce FOCUS-3D, a robust, broadly generalizable volumetric cell segmentation framework built on a large, diverse manually annotated cell resource and advanced AI designs. Integrating volumetric representation learning, multi-scale feature extraction, and query-based mask prediction, FOCUS-3D achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse species, tissues, fluorescent reporters and imaging modalities. During zebrafish (Danio rerio) development, FOCUS-3D uncovers three successive phases of notochord morphogenesis. We disentangle early motility-driven rearrangements from later cell shape remodeling and tissue repacking, and further link these morphological states to spatial and developmental transcriptional programs across independent datasets.
items.summary_zh: FOCUS-3D：面向三维荧光显微镜的稳健、可泛化体积细胞分割框架。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模人工标注资源和跨物种、组织、报告系统及成像模态的评估，使其可用于从复杂3D组织图像中提取定量细胞信息。
items.abstract_zh: 理解细胞如何在组织内建立空间组织，是生命科学中的一个基础问题。现代三维荧光显微镜能够捕获大体积组织结构，但要从复杂体积数据集中提取定量细胞信息仍是一大障碍。我们在此提出 FOCUS-3D：一个稳健且具有广泛泛化能力的体积细胞分割框架，建立在大型、多样的人工标注细胞资源和先进 AI 设计之上。FOCUS-3D 整合体积表征学习、多尺度特征提取和基于查询的掩膜预测，在不同物种、组织、荧光报告系统和成像模态中实现当前最佳性能。在斑马鱼（Danio rerio）发育过程中，FOCUS-3D 发现了脊索形态发生的连续三个阶段。我们区分了早期由运动性驱动的重排与后期细胞形状重塑和组织重新堆积，并进一步将这些形态状态与独立数据集中的空间和发育转录程序联系起来。
items.author_line: Zhang, Q., Mu, Z., Liu, B., Chi, Y., Li, D., Wang, W., Ni, J.-Q., Wan, Y., Yu, L., Navajas Acedo, J., Yu, G.

items.title: High-Resolution Spatial Transcriptomics Reveals Interferon-Associated Immune Niches and Antigen Presentation Programs in Inclusion Body Myositis
items.abstract_or_text: Inclusion body myositis (IBM) is a progressive inflammatory myopathy characterized by muscle fiber degeneration, immune infiltration, and protein aggregation. Despite the prominent immune infiltrates that characterizes IBM muscle, the factors driving immune infiltration remain unknown, and the repertoire and spatial organization of infiltrating immune populations remain poorly defined. Here, we used high-resolution spatial transcriptomic profiling to define the cellular and spatial architecture of IBM muscle. Immune profiling revealed a complex inflammatory landscape dominated by interferon-responsive CD8+ T cells and interferon-stimulated antigen-presenting macrophages, which organized into spatially localized immune hubs surrounding myofibers. Myofibers within these immune-rich microenvironments exhibited increased expression of interferon-responsive genes and HLA class I and II antigen presentation machinery components across fiber subtypes. In addition, we identified muscle-intrinsic remodeling and regenerative programs that may precede or contribute to immune recruitment, characterized by focal spatial activation of genes involved in proteostasis, cytoskeletal organization, and myofiber repair. Together, these findings define the spatial immune landscape of IBM muscle and reveal coordinated immune and muscle-intrinsic programs that shape disease pathology.
items.summary_zh: 高分辨率空间转录组描绘包涵体肌炎中的干扰素相关免疫微环境。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究提供 IBM 肌肉中 CD8+ T 细胞、巨噬细胞和肌纤维空间组织的图谱，提出疾病相关机制线索，尚不能确定免疫浸润的驱动因素。
items.abstract_zh: 包涵体肌炎（IBM）是一种进行性炎性肌病，以肌纤维退化、免疫浸润和蛋白聚集为特征。尽管 IBM 肌肉中存在显著免疫浸润，驱动免疫浸润的因素仍未知，浸润免疫群体的组成及空间组织也仍缺乏清晰描述。我们在此利用高分辨率空间转录组分析界定 IBM 肌肉的细胞和空间结构。免疫谱分析揭示出一个复杂的炎症图景，主要由对干扰素有反应的 CD8+ T 细胞和受干扰素刺激的抗原呈递巨噬细胞构成；它们组织成环绕肌纤维的局部免疫中心。这些免疫富集微环境中的肌纤维，在各纤维亚型中均表现出干扰素反应基因以及 HLA I 类和 II 类抗原呈递机制组分表达升高。此外，我们识别出可能先于免疫募集或促成免疫募集的肌肉内在重塑和再生程序，其特征为参与蛋白稳态、细胞骨架组织和肌纤维修复的基因出现局部空间激活。总体而言，这些发现界定了 IBM 肌肉的空间免疫图景，并揭示出共同塑造疾病病理的协调免疫与肌肉内在程序。
items.author_line: de Haan, S., van Andel, C. A., Heezen, L. G. M., Arens, R., Kan, H., Badrising, U. A., Mahfouz, A., Spitali, P.

items.title: A Measure of Transcriptional Dyscoordination for Quantifying Aging in Single Cells
items.abstract_or_text: Aging reshapes tissues through changes in cellular composition, coordinated transcriptional reprogramming, and loss of transcriptional coordination. Whereas the first two have been characterized across aging tissues, the third remains difficult to quantify. We introduce an unsupervised, first-principles framework for measuring transcriptional dyscoordination in single cells as deviation from a learned, predictable structure accounting for technical noise. Orthogonal validation links transcriptional dyscoordination to classical intrinsic noise and distinguishes it from coordinated change. In controlled perturbations, dyscoordination rises after genotoxic injury and senescence induction, then falls following senolytic depletion. Across mouse, rat, and human tissues, dyscoordination increases with chronological age, especially in regenerative compartments. In human T cells, dyscoordination increases with clonal expansion and effector function yet declines within persisting clones after checkpoint blockade. Cross-modal analyses further link dyscoordination to chromatin-based mitotic age and genome instability. These results identify loss of transcriptional coordination as a distinct and dynamic feature of cellular aging.
items.summary_zh: 用于量化单细胞转录失协调的新型无监督方法。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法经受控扰动、鼠、大鼠和人组织以及跨模态分析检验，为研究衰老中转录协调性变化提供与平均表达改变互补的量化指标。
items.abstract_zh: 衰老通过细胞组成改变、协调的转录重编程和转录协调性丧失重塑组织。前两者已在衰老组织中得到描述，第三者仍难以量化。我们提出一个无监督、基于第一原理的框架，将单细胞中的转录失协调定义为偏离一个已学习的、可预测结构的程度，并对技术噪声加以考虑。正交验证将转录失协调与经典内在噪声联系起来，并将其与协调性改变区分开来。在受控扰动中，失协调在基因毒性损伤和诱导衰老后升高，随后在清除衰老细胞后下降。在小鼠、大鼠和人组织中，失协调随时间年龄增加而升高，尤其见于再生区室。在人 T 细胞中，失协调随克隆扩增和效应功能增加，但在检查点阻断后持续存在的克隆内下降。跨模态分析还将失协调与基于染色质的有丝分裂年龄和基因组不稳定性联系起来。这些结果将转录协调性丧失确定为细胞衰老的一个独特且动态特征。

items.title: Beyond Execution: Auditing Experimental Fidelity in LLM-Driven Scientific Research
items.abstract_or_text: LLM agents used for scientific experimentation must do more than generate executable code: they must implement the reference method faithfully, design experiments that test the paper's claims, and provide evidence supporting those claims. We show that agents often produce methodological hallucinations: silently reducing datasets or training budgets, replacing failed learning or generative components with lookup or oracle functions, or drawing conclusions from resource-limited settings where a method's claimed advantage disappears. To detect these failures, we introduce ABE-Ralph, a reference-anchored auditing framework that represents claims, protocols, required components, baselines, and metrics as structured experimental constraints, guides implementation through an 8-step workflow, and performs quantitative, qualitative, and code-level verification. Across 30 long-horizon reproduction runs covering 12 machine learning domains, ABE-Ralph achieves a 93% robust execution rate and identifies five scientific failure modes. In 23 NatureBench discovery tasks, ABE-Ralph matches or exceeds state-of-the-art performance on 5 tasks. These results show that reliable evaluation of AI scientists must assess whether the experimental design faithfully tests the intended claim and whether the resulting evidence supports it, rather than treating code execution or plausible metrics as evidence of scientific success.
items.summary_zh: ABE-Ralph 将论文主张、协议、必需组件、基线与指标编码为实验约束，用于审计 LLM 科研代理是否忠实复现实验。在 30 次长程复现实验中，作者报告其稳健执行率为 93%，并在 23 个 NatureBench 发现任务中的 5 项达到或超过既有最佳结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把“代码能运行”与“实验是否真正检验论文主张”区分开来，为评估科研代理提供了可追溯的实验一致性标准；文中结果仍限于其所述复现任务与评测设置。
items.abstract_zh: 用于科学实验的 LLM 代理不能只生成可执行代码：它们还必须忠实实现参考方法，设计能够检验论文主张的实验，并提供支持这些主张的证据。我们表明，代理常会产生方法学幻觉：悄然缩减数据集或训练预算，用查找或预言函数替代失败的学习或生成组件，或在资源受限、方法所声称优势消失的条件下得出结论。为检测这些失败，我们引入以参考为依据的审计框架 ABE-Ralph。该框架将主张、协议、必需组件、基线和指标表示为结构化实验约束，以 8 步工作流指导实现，并进行定量、定性和代码层面的核验。在覆盖 12 个机器学习领域的 30 次长程复现实验中，ABE-Ralph 的稳健执行率达到 93%，并识别出五类科学失败模式。在 23 个 NatureBench 发现任务中，ABE-Ralph 在其中 5 项达到或超过既有最佳性能。这些结果表明，对 AI 科学家的可靠评估必须考察实验设计是否忠实检验预定主张，以及所得证据是否支持该主张，而不能把代码执行或看似合理的指标当作科学成功的证据。
items.author_line: Lezhi Yu, Xiaogang Xu, Yuhua Zhou, Shuibing He, Aimin Pan

items.title: GRAIN: Bridging Name and Narrative Shifts in Real-World Graph Reasoning through Invariance-Rewarded Agentic RL
items.abstract_or_text: Despite their potential in standardized graph tasks, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain brittle to real-world shifts in node identifiers and task formulation. While deterministic graph tools are invariant to such shifts, extracting topological structures from noisy text is highly fragile for LLMs, which often overfit to surface patterns. Moreover, mitigating these parsing failures via multi-agent systems incurs prohibitive latency. To address this, we propose GRAIN, a single-agent framework optimized via reinforcement learning. GRAIN models reasoning as a semantic parsing and tool-execution pipeline, guided by a Structure Invariance Reward. By validating extracted intermediate graphs against ground-truth topologies, this reward forces the LLM to learn robust text-to-structure mappings rather than memorizing linguistic artifacts. We also introduce GRIT, a benchmark evaluating sensitivity to such linguistic shifts. GRAIN outperforms multi-agent baselines by 16.45\% in accuracy with approximately 24\% lower latency. Furthermore, it demonstrates superior structural generalization, halving the out-of-distribution (OOD) gap of SFT models (from 15.77\% to 7.80\%) and maintaining robustness on large-scale graphs beyond the training distribution.
items.summary_zh: GRAIN 以结构不变性奖励训练单代理完成文本到图结构的解析与工具执行，并以 GRIT 基准检验节点命名和叙述方式改变时的鲁棒性。作者报告：相对多代理基线，准确率提高 16.45%，延迟约降低 24%，且将 SFT 模型的 OOD 差距从 15.77% 降至 7.80%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将图推理的可靠性测试从固定格式题目扩展到语言表述变化，直接检验模型是否保持拓扑结构；性能结论应限于 GRIT 与文中实验的图任务。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）在标准化图任务中展现出潜力，但面对真实世界中节点标识符和任务表述的变化时仍然脆弱。确定性图工具对这类变化具有不变性，而 LLM 从噪声文本中提取拓扑结构却极其脆弱，常常过拟合表面模式。此外，通过多代理系统缓解这些解析失败会带来难以承受的延迟。为此，我们提出采用强化学习优化的单代理框架 GRAIN。GRAIN 将推理建模为语义解析和工具执行流水线，并由结构不变性奖励引导。该奖励通过对照真实拓扑验证所提取的中间图，促使 LLM 学习稳健的文本到结构映射，而非记忆语言表面痕迹。我们还提出基准 GRIT，用于评估对这类语言变化的敏感性。GRAIN 的准确率比多代理基线高 16.45%，延迟约低 24%。此外，它表现出更强的结构泛化能力，将 SFT 模型的分布外（OOD）差距减半（从 15.77% 降至 7.80%），并在超出训练分布的大规模图上保持稳健性。
items.author_line: Zike Yuan, Han Zhang, Jianzhi Yan, Le Liu, Cai Ke, Huozhi Zhou, Jian Xie, Jiran Yin, Yukun Cao, Yue Yu, Hui Wang, Ming Liu, Bing Qin

items.title: SymbolLKG: Towards Verifiable Logical Reasoning via Logical Knowledge Graph and Symbolic Solvers
items.abstract_or_text: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in natural language understanding, yet they struggle with strict multi-step reasoning, frequently suffering from hallucinations and inconsistency. Existing solutions like Chain-of-Thought (CoT) lack rigorous verification mechanisms, while standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) often misses the complex, structural dependencies inherent in logical tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose a Neuro-Symbolic architecture that integrates a Logical Knowledge Graph (LKG) with dynamic solver routing. Specifically, we introduce an ontology-based LKG that treats logical rules and constraints as first-class topological nodes, enabling explicit modeling of dependencies extracted from text. We further design a Logic Router to dynamically dispatch tasks to the optimal symbolic engine, which is supported by a topology-aware hybrid retrieval mechanism. Experimental results on logical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art prompting and RAG baselines, delivering higher accuracy and verifiable reasoning paths.
items.summary_zh: SymbolLKG 将逻辑规则和约束显式编码进 Logical Knowledge Graph，并用 Logic Router 将任务分派给符号求解器，以生成可核验的逻辑推理路径。作者称其在逻辑推理基准上优于提示和 RAG 基线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把自然语言解析、显式约束和符号求解结合，可使逻辑结论对应可检查的中间结构；摘要未给出具体基准名称与数值，能力结论仍需结合论文正文核对。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在自然语言理解方面已展现出显著能力，但在严格的多步推理中仍有困难，常出现幻觉和不一致。现有解决方案如思维链（CoT）缺少严格的核验机制，而标准检索增强生成（RAG）常常遗漏逻辑任务固有的复杂结构依赖。为弥合这一差距，我们提出一种神经符号架构，将 Logical Knowledge Graph（LKG）与动态求解器路由结合起来。具体而言，我们引入基于本体的 LKG，将逻辑规则和约束视为一等拓扑节点，从而能够显式建模从文本中提取的依赖关系。我们进一步设计 Logic Router，通过具有拓扑感知能力的混合检索机制支持其将任务动态分派给最优符号引擎。逻辑推理基准上的实验结果表明，我们的框架显著优于最先进的提示和 RAG 基线，提供了更高的准确率和可核验的推理路径。

items.title: SPEAR: Distilling Domain-Adaptive Reasoning Skeletons via Sequential Symbolic Alignment in Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning-based knowledge distillation has the potential to transfer complex reasoning from teacher to student models, yet it currently faces a critical dilemma: researchers must choose between sparse outcome-based rewards, which provide insufficient logical guidance, or expensive neural Process Reward Models (PRMs) for dense signals. We resolve this by introducing SPEAR (Symbolic Process Evaluation and Alignment Reward), a training-free and plug-and-play process reward method for sequence-level on-policy distillation. SPEAR projects natural-language reasoning traces into domain-adaptive symbolic milestones, providing an efficient proxy for process-level reasoning alignment. By utilizing the longest common subsequence (LCS) to align student explorations with teacher milestones, SPEAR provides a dense, order-aware reward signal that enforces logical consistency without the need for an external neural verifier. Our experiments across math, science, and commonsense reasoning tasks demonstrate that SPEAR effectively bridges the reasoning gap between student and teacher models via sequence-level distillation with efficient dense process rewards. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/zhuochunli/SPEAR.
items.summary_zh: SPEAR 用最长公共子序列将学生模型的推理轨迹与教师模型的符号化里程碑对齐，为序列级蒸馏提供稠密、保序的过程奖励，无需额外神经验证器。作者在数学、科学和常识推理任务上进行评测，并公开代码与数据。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法试图以可显式比对的推理结构替代昂贵的过程奖励模型，适合考察蒸馏中的中间步骤监督；符号里程碑与真实证明有效性并不等同。
items.abstract_zh: 基于强化学习的知识蒸馏有望将复杂推理从教师模型迁移到学生模型，但目前面临一个关键困境：研究者必须在提供逻辑指导不足的稀疏结果奖励，和提供稠密信号却成本高昂的神经过程奖励模型（PRM）之间选择。我们通过提出 SPEAR（Symbolic Process Evaluation and Alignment Reward）解决这一问题；它是一种免训练、即插即用的过程奖励方法，用于序列级在线蒸馏。SPEAR 将自然语言推理轨迹投影为领域自适应的符号里程碑，为过程级推理对齐提供高效代理。通过使用最长公共子序列（LCS）将学生探索与教师里程碑对齐，SPEAR 提供稠密、保序的奖励信号，在无需外部神经验证器的情况下约束逻辑一致性。我们在数学、科学和常识推理任务上的实验表明，SPEAR 能够通过具有高效稠密过程奖励的序列级蒸馏，有效弥合学生与教师模型之间的推理差距。我们的代码和数据见：https://github.com/zhuochunli/SPEAR。
items.author_line: Zhuochun Li, Yuelyu Ji, Yiming Zeng, Daqing He

items.title: Safety Does Not Compose: Non-Decaying Loop State for Autonomous LLM Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed as autonomous loops. Starting from one human goal, such a system repeatedly discovers work, plans, executes tool calls, verifies outcomes and persists state across many unattended iterations. The agent safeguards in wide use, however, are defined over a single trajectory, and their safety state is re-initialized when the next trajectory begins. We show that this is a failure of composition rather than an implementation detail. Our central result is a separation: against an attack whose evidence is fragmented across several iterations, every trajectory-scoped monitor has a true-positive rate equal to its false-positive rate, however expressive it is, because the evidence it would need never appears in the window it sees, whereas a monitor retaining cross-iteration state separates the two perfectly. We further show that the obvious repair of carrying a geometrically decaying risk score is insufficient, because the cooling-off period a patient adversary must wait is a constant that does not grow with the horizon N. We then present LoopHarness, which restores a persistent, non-decaying safety state at the loop level. Under mediated commits and an arbiter detection floor δ_M, it bounds the expected number of unauthorized irreversible actions by B+m-1+m/δ_M, a constant in N, of which the B+m-1 term is decided by a model-free rule and therefore survives a fully colluding verifier. We give a complete evaluation protocol on native Agent-SafetyBench tasks with paired clean and attacked episodes, an outer-state attack suite whose decisive evidence exists only across iterations, per-module ablations, and an adaptive white-box red team.
items.summary_zh: 该文分析自主 LLM 代理跨多轮迭代时安全监测状态被重置的问题，给出轨迹级监测器的理论分离结果，并提出保留非衰减状态的 LoopHarness。作者同时给出 Agent-SafetyBench 上配对洁净/攻击情节、跨迭代攻击集、消融和白盒红队组成的评测协议。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其理论论证说明，若决定性攻击证据被分散在多轮中，单轮监测难以识别；这为长期运行代理的可验证安全评测提出了明确对象，但仍是预印本中的理论与实验方案。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型代理日益被部署为自主循环。从一个人类目标开始，这样的系统会在许多无人值守的迭代中反复发现工作、规划、执行工具调用、核验结果并持久化状态。然而，被广泛使用的代理安全措施是针对单条轨迹定义的，当下一条轨迹开始时，其安全状态会重新初始化。我们表明，这是一种组合失败，而非实现细节。我们的核心结果是一个分离结论：面对证据分散在多次迭代中的攻击，每个以轨迹为范围的监测器，无论表达能力多强，其真阳性率都等于假阳性率，因为它所需的证据从未出现在它能看到的窗口中；而保留跨迭代状态的监测器能够将两者完全分离。我们进一步表明，显而易见的修复方案——携带几何衰减的风险分数——并不充分，因为耐心的对手需要等待的冷却期是一个不随时域 N 增长的常数。随后，我们提出 LoopHarness，在循环层面恢复持久、非衰减的安全状态。在经中介的提交和仲裁器检测下限 δ_M 的条件下，它将未经授权的不可逆操作的期望次数限制为 B+m-1+m/δ_M；该量关于 N 为常数，其中 B+m-1 项由模型无关规则决定，因此即使验证器完全串通也仍然有效。我们给出一套完整评测协议，包括原生 Agent-SafetyBench 任务上的配对洁净与受攻击情节、决定性证据只跨迭代存在的外部状态攻击集、逐模块消融，以及自适应白盒红队测试。
items.author_line: Chenhao Wu, Haoxuan Jia, Yang Liu, Yingguang Yang, Yuhan Lin, Chongyang Zhang, Hao Zheng, Yulin Huang, Jianshen Zhang, Yongzhi Qi, Shang Luo, Kefu Xu, Jifeng Zhu, Bin Chong

items.title: Multi-Expert Conformal Risk Control for Pairwise LLM Judging in Open-Ended Dialogue
items.abstract_or_text: In this paper, we explore multi-expert Conformal Risk Control (CRC) algorithms for pairwise LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation in open-ended dialogue. Our core insight is that multi-expert aggregation offers a complementary remedy to CRC: whereas CRC controls risk at the decision threshold through abstention, aggregation sanitizes the scoring function at its source. Guided by this, we first design two multi-expert CRC methods: Score Averaging and Decision Voting, which aggregate at the score and decision levels, respectively. While both strategies outperform single-expert methods on homogeneous expert panels, on heterogeneous LLM judges they remain risk-valid but recover only limited coverage, because a uniform threshold cannot match the experts' distinct scoring scales. To resolve this issue, we further propose Marginal-Calibrated Conformal Consensus (MC3): it captures distinct per-expert scales via initial threshold ratios, while jointly tuning a unified decision function C_t(x) applied identically in both calibration and test, thereby preserving exchangeability. To evaluate our framework, we construct Panel, a 1,800-pair human pairwise-preference benchmark for open-ended dialogue. It is built on responses generated by four open-weight LLMs over dialogue contexts from three domains (ESConv, MSC, DREAM), with full logit access. In experiments, we find that both Score Averaging and Decision Voting substantially improve accuracy and acceptance rate on homogeneous panels. Notably, MC3 extends these gains to heterogeneous panels by accommodating distinct per-expert scoring scales across all three datasets.
items.summary_zh: 该文研究开放式对话中 LLM-as-a-Judge 的成对比较，提出 Score Averaging、Decision Voting 和 Marginal-Calibrated Conformal Consensus（MC3）等多专家保形风险控制方法，并构建含 1,800 对人工偏好的 Panel 基准。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 保形风险控制为 LLM 评审的弃权阈值提供统计风险约束；Panel 的异质评审设置可检验多专家校准是否同时保持风险有效性与可接受覆盖率。
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究用于开放式对话中成对 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估的多专家保形风险控制（CRC）算法。我们的核心见解是，多专家聚合可为 CRC 提供互补性补救：CRC 通过弃权在决策阈值处控制风险，聚合则从源头净化评分函数。在此指导下，我们首先设计两种多专家 CRC 方法：Score Averaging 和 Decision Voting，分别在评分和决策层面进行聚合。尽管两种策略在同质专家组上都优于单专家方法，但在异质 LLM 评审器上，它们仍然具有风险有效性，却只能恢复有限的覆盖率，因为统一阈值无法匹配专家不同的评分尺度。为解决这一问题，我们进一步提出 Marginal-Calibrated Conformal Consensus（MC3）：它通过初始阈值比率捕捉每位专家不同的尺度，同时联合调节统一的决策函数 C_t(x)，并在校准和测试中以相同方式应用该函数，从而保持可交换性。为评估我们的框架，我们构建了 Panel：一个包含 1,800 对人工成对偏好的开放式对话基准。它建立在四个开放权重大语言模型针对三个领域（ESConv、MSC、DREAM）对话语境所生成的回答之上，并具有完整 logit 访问权限。在实验中，我们发现 Score Averaging 和 Decision Voting 都能在同质专家组上显著提高准确率和接受率。值得注意的是，MC3 通过适应所有三个数据集上专家不同的评分尺度，将这些收益扩展到异质专家组。

items.abstract_or_text: My best rough estimate of the fraction of the scientific literature that’s wrong — flat-out wrong, you’d-be-nuts-to-rely-on-this wrong — is 80%. The problem is that the normal process of scientific self-correction takes time and happens through follow-up work that fails to reproduce experiments, finds computational errors, challenges assumptions, and so on. This is a big opportunity for AI-for-science tools. Agentic interfaces to the scientific literature should be designed so that when they look up a paper they should explicitly look for later work that challenges it.

items.abstract_zh: 我对科学文献中错误——彻头彻尾的错误，依赖它们会很愚蠢的错误——所占比例的最佳粗略估计是80%。问题在于，科学自我纠正的正常过程需要时间；它通过后续工作来完成，后续工作会未能复现实验、发现计算错误、质疑假设，等等。这对 AI for Science 工具而言是一个巨大机会。面向科学文献的智能体界面应当设计为：在查找一篇论文时，明确寻找后来对其提出质疑的工作。

At @OpenAI we aim to devote time to finding and announcing math results from internal models only when they would meaningfully change people’s understanding of the pace of AI progress. Our main focus is shipping great models so everyone can use them to make discoveries of their own.
items.summary_zh: Noam Brown 说明，OpenAI 只会在内部模型取得的数学成果足以显著改变公众对 AI 进展速度的理解时，才投入资源寻找并公布这些结果；他表示团队主要工作仍是推出可供用户使用的模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一位研究者对能力披露标准的公开说明，涉及研究展示、公众预期与产品交付之间的取舍；它不构成新的数学能力证据。
items.abstract_zh: 今天有人问我，为什么自这些问题以来我们没有公布 Astra 更多数学成果。在 OpenAI，我们力求只在那些成果会显著改变人们对 AI 进展速度的理解时，才投入时间从内部模型中寻找并公布数学成果。我们的主要重点是推出出色的模型，让每个人都能用它们做出自己的发现。
items.author_line: Noam Brown

items.title: @fchollet：Figuring out the origins of cosmic rays (e.g. supernova, black hole...) from ground-based detector arrays is a notorious
items.abstract_or_text: Figuring out the origins of cosmic rays (e.g. supernova, black hole...) from ground-based detector arrays is a notoriously difficult inverse problem. This post walks through how astroparticle physicists are using Keras to replace the usual hand-crafted features and directly model the raw spatio-temporal waveforms
items.summary_zh: François Chollet 介绍了一项天体粒子物理工作：研究者使用 Keras 替代传统手工特征，直接对地面阵列记录的原始时空波形建模，以处理宇宙射线来源推断这一逆问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是将深度学习用于科学仪器原始信号的明确工程例子，讨论重点从特征设计转向端到端表示学习；帖文未给出误差、数据规模或对照结果，因此不宜外推性能结论。
items.abstract_zh: 从地面探测器阵列推断宇宙射线的来源（如超新星、黑洞等）是一个极其困难的逆问题。这篇文章介绍了天体粒子物理学家如何使用 Keras 取代通常的手工特征，直接建模原始时空波形。
items.author_line: François Chollet
